headline: If your newborn only falls asleep while feeding
body: Sucking, warmth, a full belly and your smell are some of the most soothing things a newborn knows.

So when they drift off mid-feed, they're not "learning a crutch."
/They're doing what newborns tend to do./

And a feed that ends in sleep still counts.
/No need to wake them to prove a point./
Many babies find other ways to fall asleep as they grow.
For now, you get to be the easy way.
